description: This PHP class 'VacancyAttachmentDecorator' serves as a decorator for the 'VacancyAttachment' entity in the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin, providing additional functionality such as retrieving file content and setting vacancy references by ID.

classes.name: VacancyAttachmentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that adds functionality to the VacancyAttachment entity, including content retrieval and vacancy assignment.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Returns the file content associated with the vacancy attachment, reading from a resource if necessary.

methods.name: setVacancyById
methods.description: Associates the decorator with a Vacancy entity based on its ID.
